title: Daytime Dehazing Density Consistency CARL Multiseed Training State Integrity v1
rationale: The archived receipt-bound engineering contract failed before workload start at seed 20260803, arm b10_carl, step 427 with non-finite synthetic_parameter_state. GitHub-main commit 0a7a1762065cd7418e1966a58a2e06243d44d440 preserves the canonical closeout at SHA-256 c27a401a7240d5d8d8b615c3e0a82f0e4dffedd9ba00e740a6f9f66a962e189a, with decision null, authorizes=NONE, no scientific-data touch, and no protected-data touch. A source-bound review found five contract-integrity hazards that the failed diagnostic could not distinguish: batch size 2 duplicated one scene through a 1x1 BatchNorm path; FP32 L2 norms could overflow while their tensors remained elementwise finite; the consistency pair could equal the primary observation; EMA updated parameters but omitted BatchNorm buffers; and the fixed-linear cost map omitted all 12000 formal evaluation forwards and contradicted the declared wall bound. This formal amendment repairs those fixed factors together because leaving any one unresolved could invalidate the next run. The scientific 2x2 intervention, five seeds, Haze4K roles, 2000-step cell budget, optimizer, learning rate, CARL and consistency definitions and weights, raw estimands, uncertainty, gates, sequential boundaries, and 41-unit ledger remain unchanged. Under the authoritative 900-second qualification cap, the protected-data-free fixed-linear probe exercises 800 steps per arm and 10 synthetic scenes with four evaluation observations per arm, totaling 3360 exact-path composite iterations and extending beyond the archived step-427 failure point in every arm. It uses two distinct synthetic scenes per training batch, strictly distinct same-scene consistency observations, EMA over parameters and buffers, named elementwise finite checks, and bounded result-blind heartbeats. The formal cost map separately includes all 40000 training iterations and 12000 evaluation forwards. The qualification tests the corrected path as a whole and cannot attribute success to one repair or guarantee later scientific utility. Any non-finite value, identity mismatch, incomplete map, or cost violation fails without filtering, replacement, retry, or scientific interpretation. Development evidence cannot authorize confirmation, sealed-final access, promotion, deployment, publication, or another repair route.

orthogonal_changes.reason: The unchanged multiseed precision route cannot reach a scientific terminal until the archived non-finite parameter-state failure and the source-bound training-state integrity hazards are addressed. This evidence-bound route preserves the raw estimands and seed-blocking model while applying only the formally amended operational fixed factors.

scientific_contract.question: With the amended training-state integrity controls applied without changing the frozen scientific intervention, is the official ConvIR-B 2x2 CARL-by-density-consistency route finite and identity-valid through all five seed blocks, and if so is the raw combined-versus-baseline scene PSNR effect material and directionally stable while the two main effects and interaction remain separable under one simultaneous comparison family?

primary_estimand.aggregation: Within each seed and original-clear scene, average the four haze-observation PSNR values for each arm and compute the raw finite b11_combined minus b00_baseline difference without clipping or winsorization. At each predeclared look, average the completed paired-seed differences within scene, then report the scene mean, the five seed-specific scene means, and the three fixed density-stratum scene means. Seeds are frozen paired blocks and never increase the independent scene count.

gates.reference: Exact route, code, checkpoint, VGG asset, role ledger, arm, seed, grouping, look, gate, explicit CUDA TF32 disablement, and finite-assertion identities must match the generated contract.

The SHA-bound ledger must cover exactly twenty training cells, twenty seed-by-arm evaluation bundles that each retain all 150 development scenes, and one terminal summary. Units skipped only by the frozen three-seed futility rule remain explicit typed skipped outputs, so every valid terminal covers exactly 41 units.

Every fixed density-stratum raw combined-effect interval must have half-width at most 0.260 dB at the final look; actual observed uncertainty, not the transferred planning bound, determines this gate.

At the terminal look, the simultaneous lower bound of the raw seed-blocked b11-minus-b00 scene effect must exceed the unchanged +0.10 dB minimum meaningful effect. At the three-seed look, an upper bound at or below +0.10 dB triggers nonbinding futility and a scientific FAIL.

At the terminal five-seed look, every seed-specific raw combined-effect simultaneous interval must have a lower bound above 0.0 dB for stable direction. At either look, any completed seed-specific upper bound at or below 0.0 dB is unstable; otherwise the gate is indeterminate.

At the terminal look, each of the CARL main effect, consistency main effect, and interaction must be classified by its simultaneous interval as materially positive above +0.05 dB, materially negative below -0.05 dB, or equivalent-to-small wholly inside [-0.05,+0.05] dB. Any crossing interval leaves mechanism attribution unresolved.

The route is safe only when every fixed density-stratum simultaneous lower bound for the raw seed-blocked b11-minus-b00 effect is at least -0.10 dB. It is unsafe when any stratum upper bound is below -0.10 dB; otherwise it is indeterminate.

research_update_binding.bottleneck_statement: The multiseed scientific question remains unresolved because the latest protected-data-free qualification failed before workload start with a non-finite synthetic parameter state at seed 20260803, arm b10_carl, step 427. The failure names the first observed state class but not the responsible tensor or mechanism. Source-bound review also found independent batch-composition, finite-check, consistency-pair, EMA-buffer, cost-map, lifecycle-heartbeat, evidence-filename, and evaluation-lifetime hazards. One formal amendment must close the full training-state integrity surface before another scientific interpretation is possible.

literature_basis.task: explicit CUDA TF32 backend control for float32 matmul and cuDNN operations
literature_basis.transferable_claim: PyTorch exposes separate matmul and cuDNN controls that can explicitly disable TF32 execution on Ampere-class and later CUDA devices.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The framework documentation does not establish that TF32 caused this route's non-finite value or that disabling it will make ConvIR-B training finite; that claim is tested by the frozen full-path diagnostic.

literature_basis.task: BatchNorm2d batch and spatial statistic semantics
literature_basis.transferable_claim: BatchNorm2d computes per-channel statistics over the batch and spatial dimensions and maintains running statistics used during evaluation.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The documentation supports preserving non-degenerate batch composition and running-buffer identity, but it does not prove that duplicated scenes caused the archived non-finite parameter state.

literature_basis.task: complete module state identity for EMA
literature_basis.transferable_claim: A module state dict contains both parameters and persistent buffers, so an EMA teacher that claims complete model state must account for both classes.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: Complete EMA state removes a contract mismatch but does not establish which repair, if any, is sufficient for numerical stability or scientific utility.

literature_basis.transferable_claim: torch.isfinite classifies each tensor element directly, avoiding a derived FP32 norm whose reduction may overflow even when all source elements are finite.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: Elementwise checking prevents a false diagnostic classification; it does not make a genuinely non-finite parameter finite.

literature_basis.task: contrast-assisted reconstruction and haze-density consistency training losses
literature_basis.transferable_claim: A component factorial can separate reconstruction contrast loss, haze-density consistency, and their combination in a dehazing training objective.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The published FFA-Net/RESIDE K=5 results do not predict ConvIR-B/Haze4K effect sizes, seed stability, thresholds, or PASS criteria; this route preserves the prior K=4 transfer.

literature_basis.task: variance accounting in machine-learning benchmark comparisons
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Training randomness and data-sampling variability can materially change benchmark comparisons and should be represented in experimental design.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The paper does not determine this route's seed count, PSNR threshold, Haze4K variance, or scientific outcome.

literature_basis.task: influence of random seeds in computer-vision deep learning
literature_basis.transferable_claim: A single seed can be atypically favorable or unfavorable, motivating predeclared repeated seeds and score distributions.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The paper does not establish that five seeds exhaust the training-seed distribution or validate any dehazing mechanism.

literature_basis.task: reporting score distributions across repeated neural-network runs
literature_basis.transferable_claim: Distributional reporting across repeated runs is more informative than one point estimate.
literature_basis.applicability_limit: The sequence-tagging results do not transfer numerically to image restoration and provide no dehazing threshold.

design_selection.decision_value: One route first tests the amended training-state path on a protected-data-free fixed-linear probe: all four 800-step arm trajectories, each beyond the archived step-427 failure point, plus 40 evaluation forwards per arm. Only after that probe passes does the unchanged full seed-blocked 2x2 scientific decision on raw utility and factorial attribution become eligible.
design_selection.expected_time_to_decision: A non-finite or identity-invalid engineering state stops before scientific-data access with phase, seed, arm, step, and named state class. If the exact engineering map is finite and within cost, the unchanged nonbinding futility look after three scientific seed blocks can stop a non-material or directionally failed replication; otherwise the terminal five-seed look resolves the frozen decision table.
design_selection.shared_setup: Engineering and scientific cells share the official ConvIR-B architecture, checkpoint, optimizer, two-distinct-scene batch, strictly distinct consistency pair, complete EMA state, VGG identity, losses, explicit TF32 disablement, named elementwise finite assertions, evaluation implementation, and bounded heartbeat path. The fixed-linear probe uses the exact shapes and code branches at 800 rather than 2000 training steps and 10 rather than 150 evaluation scenes per arm; scientific cells use only the unchanged Haze4K roles, full evaluation roster, and density strata.
design_selection.worst_case_stopping_cost: The protected-data-free qualification executes 3360 composite iterations: 3200 training iterations and 160 evaluation forwards, under the authoritative 900-second cap. If it passes, the formal worst case is 52000 composite iterations under a 21600-second mechanical bound. The three-seed futility boundary costs 24000 training iterations plus 7200 evaluation forwards before sixteen typed skipped units; the first non-finite, identity, coverage, or cost failure stops without filtering or retry.

decision_design.multiplicity_control: The terminal family contains twelve simultaneous two-sided Bonferroni comparisons: the combined primary, CARL main effect, consistency main effect, interaction, three density-stratum combined effects, and five seed-specific combined effects. Only the first three seed-specific comparisons are observed at the nonbinding futility look, but the frozen terminal-family critical value 2.865 is conservatively used at both looks. The three-seed look cannot produce efficacy PASS and therefore spends no efficacy alpha.

boundaries.success: No early efficacy terminal is permitted. PASS is available only after all five seed blocks, exact ledger coverage, and every decisive gate passes.
boundaries.futility: After three complete seed blocks, stop and write all remaining seed units as typed skipped outputs when the combined raw upper bound is at or below +0.10 dB or any completed seed-specific raw upper bound is at or below 0.0 dB.
boundaries.precision: At the terminal five-seed look, any fixed density-stratum half-width above 0.260 dB is inconclusive-only and cannot hide a decisive combined, seed, or safety FAIL.
boundaries.validity: Any route, asset, data-role, grouping, arm, seed, look, protected-access, output, or exact completed-unit-ledger failure triggers the validity veto.

precision_contract.rationale: The raw primary and fixed density-stratum contrasts require a pre-run planning-SD transfer bound and actual terminal uncertainty. The largest archived RESIDE development upper bound is transferred conservatively with explicit cross-dataset limitations.

capability.production_path_statement: The protected-data-free fixed-linear qualification explicitly disables CUDA TF32 and executes the first frozen seed through every arm-specific model, complete EMA teacher, optimizer, CARL, consistency, named elementwise finite assertion, heartbeat, and evaluation production branch for 800 training steps and 40 evaluation forwards per arm, exactly 3360 composite CUDA iterations. It extends beyond the archived step-427 failure point in every arm. Each training batch contains two distinct synthetic scenes, each consistency pair is a distinct observation of the same synthetic clear scene, and the exact formal fixed-count map contains 40000 training iterations plus 12000 evaluation forwards. Batch shape and memory scaling are fixed, there is no candidate schedule or adaptive contract termination, and the qualification reads no Haze4K image or role outcome, trains no scientific weight, and creates no scientific result. Any non-finite or identity-invalid value fails immediately without replacement or omission.

assurance.planning_sd_rule: Use 0.632364322219979 dB, the larger archived 1.05-multiplied planning-SD upper bound from 1587-scene development-only RESIDE ITS/OTS continuous-utility evidence. This is a conservative feasibility transfer, not an observed Haze4K variance or a guarantee; actual Haze4K raw intervals own the inconclusive-only precision gate.
